items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: Yeah, it was Jake Steve, the one who had the contract.

ctx.x: Yes. We were just talking about him.

They used to play together. In those parades. Yeah, those parades. Well, I think that's how Papa played all the carnival parades, was through Jake Steve. No, I mean Piku used to play. Oh, yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, it was Jake Steve, the one who had the contract. And he would be, you know, the leading. Oh, he always played the first horn. The first. Carnet, whatever. In those days they called it the carnet.
I wonder, did he ever talk about who his teacher was, or if he had more than one teacher? Well, no.
